title: Word Drop
description: Herb's beach photos play as sunny handheld footage. Tap anywhere and the next word of the line pops in right there in big white Arial, stuck to the scene as the camera drifts; finish the line and the next tap hard-cuts to a new shot.
intent: The daytime lyric-edit look from herb's board, where words sit next to the people in frame: you are the editor placing each word with a tap, CapCut stepped pop and all, and the words are tracked to the image rather than the screen.
sources: herb reference board: 7af8701e daytime handheld lyric edit (big words placed beside people)
